title: Investigate (read-only) why model calls on the OpenRouter route record input tokens as 0 in the Rust workspace at /home…
summary: OpenRouter route calls record 0 input tokens because our stream parser only reads input usage from `message_start`. For non-Anthropic models, OpenRouter's `message_start` carries no real numbers and the real ones come in the final `message_delta`, where we read only `output_tokens`. The cache counters are lost the same way. I made no edits.
